note: Protocol identified and implemented: Sony20, cited from DecodeIR and independently named as the protocol for Sony Blu-ray players by IRDB. Still blocked on per-button function codes for THIS remote, and the evidence now complicates SPEC section 1's claim rather than supporting it: IRDB's Sony Blu-ray player entry is device 26 subdevice 226, not 218; its 26,218 file is a PlayStation button set (SELECT, L3, TRIANGLE, CROSS); and subdevices 234 and 242 do not appear under Sony at all. SPEC section 1 cites hifi-remote.com's official Sony BD command table for the 218/234/242 addressing, and that table remains unretrieved -- so this needs its originally cited source rather than a substitute. Authoring 26,226's codes would be a different remote whose model IRDB does not record.
